title: Problems with fixpoints of polynomials of polynomials
summary: Motivated by applications in computable analysis, we study fixpoints of certain endofunctors over categories of containers. More specifically, we focus on fibred endofunctors over the fibrewise opposite of the codomain fibration that can be themselves be represented by families of polynomial endofunctors. In this setting, we show how to compute initial algebras, terminal coalgebras and another kind of fixpoint $ζ$.
